facts.fact: 十二辆装甲运输车与一个步兵排的增援冲到北岭，车轮在血浸的泥地里打滑，战场已经打完了
facts.quote: A dozen armored transports and a platoon of infantry crested the northern ridge at full speed and found nothing left to fight.

facts.fact: 尸体中除变异兽外，还包括四名 Spartans 和八名士兵
facts.quote: Mutants’ corpses littered the ground, among them four Spartans and eight soldiers.

facts.fact: 随增援抵达的 Colonel Karrik 下令保留一具变异兽尸体供研究，另两具标记后运回丹佛的基地
facts.quote: Colonel Karrik, who had arrived with the reinforcements, ordered one mutant corpse preserved for study.

facts.fact: Drakken 没有变身，走到尸堆前伸出单手释放龙火，把所有变异兽尸体烧成灰烬后一言不发地转身离开
facts.quote: He didn’t shift to do it. He walked to the pile in borrowed trousers and held out one hand.

facts.fact: Sparta 用自己的斗篷裹住阵亡者，把擦净的武器放在他们胸前
facts.quote: The warriors’ bodies, wrapped in their own cloaks, lay at the base. Weapons cleaned and placed across their chests.

facts.fact: Drakken 亲自接过 Spartan 递来的火把，用打火石自己点火，没有动用龙火
facts.quote: A Spartan held out an unadorned torch. Drakken took it and struck the flint himself. He didn’t use his dragon fire.

facts.fact: Aelindor 在柴堆前起唱 Spartans 的挽歌，Sparta 随后集体应和
facts.quote: And then Aelindor began to sing.

facts.fact: Caspian 仰头发出长嚎，Sparta 与 Max 都以嚎叫回应
facts.quote: Caspian threw his head back and howled.

relations: 阵亡的四名 Spartans 与八名士兵是 Max 和三位继承人的同袍
Max 因变异兽群是冲自己而来而愧疚自责，Spartan 不让她插手收殓
Colonel Karrik 是 Greyhold 的指挥官，随增援抵达战场并决定变异兽尸体的处置
Greyhold 的医疗队负责收治伤员与收殓遗体
Drakken 是龙族继承人，徒手释放龙火焚烧变异兽尸体
Sparta 自行在营地东侧搭起柴堆安葬同袍，阵亡者的徽章别针将送回要塞的纪念墙
Aelindor 是 Fae 继承人，为死去的 Spartans 领唱挽歌
Caspian 是狼族继承人，以长嚎领哀，Max 与全体一起嚎叫致哀
Max 是 Sparta 的新兵（第一年学员），与死者的同袍身份产生落差
numbers: Two more were tagged for transport
